Description: Automatic re-enrollment for certificates in Akamai certificate stores

ConfigurationParameters.ScriptContent:
$result = @{}
# Workflow Configuration settings
$result.Add("STORE_TYPE_NAME", "Akamai")
$result.Add("API_URL", "<!API URL>")
$result.Add("API_SUBPATH", "<!API Subpath>")

# Set defaults for CA and Template in case the certificate being renewed uses a CA or Template not in KF Command
$result.Add("DEFAULT_CA", "<!CA Host Name>\<!CA Logical Name>")
$result.Add("DEFAULT_TEMPLATE", "<!Certificate Template>")


return $result

param(
$certStoreId,
$subject,
$thumbprint,
$ca,
$template,
$getStoreResponse,
$sans,
$getStoreInventoryResponse,
$DEFAULT_CA,
$DEFAULT_TEMPLATE
)

$storeConfig = $getStoreResponse | ConvertFrom-Json
$inventoryList = $getStoreInventoryResponse | ConvertFrom-Json

# COMPATIBILITY NOTE: this should be uncommented for KF Command Versions 12.2 and below, which require accessing the Result object
# need to access the Result element of the response objects in KF 11 -> 12.2
# $storeConfig = $storeConfig.Result
# $inventoryList = $inventoryList.Result

# check if CA and Template were provided
# IF NOT: use Workflow Defaults
if($ca -notcontains '\') # $ca was not provided, did not match expected format
{
    $ca = $DEFAULT_CA
    $template = $DEFAULT_TEMPLATE
}

# get entry parameters for the previous certificate from inventory from Akamai store
$entryParameters = @{}
foreach($inventoryItem in $inventoryList)
{
    if ($inventoryItem.Name -eq $thumbprint)
    {
        $entryParameters = $inventoryItem.Parameters
    }
}

# merge filtered sans with entry parameters
$entryParameters.Sans = $sans

$entryParametersJson = $entryParameters | ConvertTo-Json

# remove new lines from JSON for submitting body
$entryParametersJson = $entryParametersJson -replace "`n","" -replace "`r",""

# escape ca 
$escapedCA = $ca -replace '\\', '\\'

$result = @{}
$result.Add("KeystoreId", $certStoreId)
$result.Add("SubjectName", $subject)
$result.Add("AgentGuid", $storeConfig.AgentId)
$result.Add("Alias", $thumbprint)
$result.Add("JobProperties", $entryParametersJson)
$result.Add("CertificateAuthority", $escapedCA)
$result.Add("CertificateTemplate", $template)

return $result
